source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-6

procedures.title: Heater control head assembly: remove and install
steps: Remove the floor console trim plate screws and take off the trim plate.
Remove the control panel screw and lift the panel, pulling it back slightly.
Disconnect the bowden cables and wiring and remove the control head.
notes: See figure 11 in the manual (Corvette control head; view A shows the temperature and air-defrost cables and the blower switch).

procedures.title: Defroster duct: remove and install
steps: Remove the air distributor duct as described under Air Distributor Duct and Core.
notes: See figure 12 in the manual for defroster duct installation (Corvette view included).
